name: toast
title: Toast
description: Transient notifications with accessible actions and dismissal.

motionProfile.reason: Toast owns its own surface presence, its scoped surface and foreground paint, the title/description display slots and the built-in icon's loading clock; Base UI keeps the stack geometry, swipe, timers and dismissal, and Button-backed actions keep their button owners.

enter.pop/one-shot.reason: A later manager add fades and scales its own root in at the stack position Base UI placed it.

exit.fade/one-shot.reason: The root keeps one opacity envelope until Base UI's own completion removes the toast; no extra timer or hold is added.
ToastAction and ToastClose render Button, which keeps its own retained exit, paint, label, quantity and press owners.

data.transition/continuous.reason: The loading glyph runs the theme-clock spin only while that type is current and visible.

state.color/css-transition.reason: The root's supplied surface and border tokens transition as one scoped family, and title/description own their foreground region; an unprovable caller palette settles immediately.
ToastAction and ToastClose render Button, which keeps its own retained exit, paint, label, quantity and press owners.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: A primitive title or description string replaces only its changed runs on the same display slot.
ToastAction and ToastClose render Button, which keeps its own retained exit, paint, label, quantity and press owners.

number.roll/reels.reason: A directly supplied supported numeric title or description reels only its changed places.
ToastAction and ToastClose render Button, which keeps its own retained exit, paint, label, quantity and press owners.

feedback.press/one-shot.reason: ToastAction and ToastClose render Button, which keeps its own press layer and native activation.

props.reason: The close control names the composed slot for the same reason: Button keeps its own owners and the toast never writes that region.
